name: VINU
fix_description: Add onlyOwner modifier to addLiquidityETH. Currently anyone can call it with an arbitrary devaddr and steal 80% of that address token balance by transferring it to the contract and adding liquidity.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit centered on abusing a token’s unsafe addLiquidityETH integration by supplying a fake router, then syncing and swapping against the manipulated Uniswap pair. It involves only a few external calls and no flash loan or deep protocol-specific reasoning, so a competent auditor could likely reproduce it quickly.
